_doc: v0.19.3 WS3 · 预标注能力判据跨端契约 fixture (单一事实源)。后端 pytest 喂 services/pipeline_validation.check_capability_violations 断言违例码集合; 前端 vitest 喂 pipelineGraph.stageWarning 断言首条警示。任一端判据漂移 → 对应端测试红。每例至多触发一条判据 (除显式 both 例), expect_codes 顺序与后端一致 (batchable 先于 class); 前端单条警示取 expect_codes[0]。

codes.not_batchable: resource_profile.batchable 显式 false (交互/有状态) → 不能批量预标
codes.no_class_attribute: 写属性的下游, 模型自报 output_attribute_types 非空但不含 class → 属性恒空

cases.name: source model not batchable (源阶段 batchable=false)
downstream not batchable, no attr types (下游 batchable=false)
both fire: not batchable + no class (batchable 优先)
downstream writes attrs but model lacks class (无 class 属性)
downstream produces class (含 class → 放行)
old backend: no resource_profile, no attr types (零退化放行)
lacks class but does NOT write attrs (writes_attributes 门控 → 不触发)
resource_profile present but batchable absent (缺省不触发)
ocr recognize downstream: text not class (识别下游 task=ocr → 放行)
ocr recognize but not batchable (识别下游 task=ocr 仍受 batchable 拦)
